## Hypothesis

Assess whether the STRUCTURE_VETO_DIR_VS_TREND veto's edge capture and Sharpe degrade across recent quarters (2025 Q3, 2026 Q1, 2026 Q2) to detect regime-dependent decay or overfit.

## Mechanism

The candidate's real-fills A/B report (full OPRA 2025-01-02..2026-06-18) shows overall edge_capture unchanged at $780 and Sharpe improved from 4.34 to 4.73. To evaluate walk‑forward stability we need the equity curve split into the three target quarters, then compute per‑quarter edge_capture (sum of engine P&L on J‑winner days minus sum of max(0, engine loss on J‑loser days) within that quarter) and Sharpe (annualized mean/StdDev of daily returns). Degradation is indicated by a monotonic decline in either metric or a quarter with negative edge_capture.
